approve(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-approve}. NOTE: If `amount` is the maximum `uint256`, the allowance is not updated on `transferFrom`. This is semantically equivalent to an infinite approval. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address.

params._amount: number of strategy tokens (1:1 with underlyings) to burn

claimWithdrawRequest(address).details: we burn the strategy tokens and transfer the underlying tokens

collectInstantWithdrawFunds(uint256).details: only IdleCDO can call this function

collectWithdrawFunds(uint256).details: only IdleCDO can call this function

decreaseAllowance(address,uint256).details: Atomically decreases the allowance granted to `spender` by the caller. This is an alternative to {approve} that can be used as a mitigation for problems described in {IERC20-approve}. Emits an {Approval} event indicating the updated allowance. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address. - `spender` must have allowance for the caller of at least `subtractedValue`.

increaseAllowance(address,uint256).details: Atomically increases the allowance granted to `spender` by the caller. This is an alternative to {approve} that can be used as a mitigation for problems described in {IERC20-approve}. Emits an {Approval} event indicating the updated allowance. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address.

params._underlyingToken: address of the underlying token (pool currency)

mintStrategyTokens(uint256).details: Used for mid-epoch deposits that send funds directly to the borrower

name().details: Returns the name of the token.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

requestInstantWithdraw(uint256,address).details: we burn strategy tokens here, and we increase the instant withdraw requests

requestWithdraw(uint256,address,uint256).details: we don't burn strategy tokens here, but we increase the withdraw requests

params._netInterest: net interest gained in the next epoch

setApr(uint256).details: only cdo and manager can set the apr. If manager manually set apr from  here it will not be scaled to include the buffer period

setAprs(uint256,uint256).details: only cdo and manager can set the apr.

symbol().details: Returns the symbol of the token, usually a shorter version of the name.

transfer(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transfer}. Requirements: - `to` cannot be the zero address. - the caller must have a balance of at least `amount`.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transferFrom}. Emits an {Approval} event indicating the updated allowance. This is not required by the EIP. See the note at the beginning of {ERC20}. NOTE: Does not update the allowance if the current allowance is the maximum `uint256`. Requirements: - `from` and `to` cannot be the zero address. - `from` must have a balance of at least `amount`. - the caller must have allowance for ``from``'s tokens of at least `amount`.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

params._token: address of the token to transfer

YEAR().notice: one year, used to calculate the APR

burnStrategyTokens(uint256).notice: Burn strategy tokens from the CDO

deposit(uint256).notice: Get funds from IdleCDO and mint strategy tokens. Funds are not sent to the borrower here

getApr().notice: current fixed apr for the epoch

lastApr().notice: latest saved apr, already scaled to include the buffer period

lastWithdrawRequest(address).notice: last withdraw request epoch for a user

mintStrategyTokens(uint256).notice: Mint strategy tokens to the CDO without moving underlyings

price().notice: return strategy token price which is always 1

redeem(uint256).notice: Not used as redeems happens only via requestWithdraw and requestInstantWithdraw

redeemUnderlying(uint256).notice: Not used as redeems happens only via requestWithdraw and requestInstantWithdraw

requestInstantWithdraw(uint256,address).notice: request instant withdraw of underlying token from the vault

requestWithdraw(uint256,address,uint256).notice: request withdraw of underlying token from the vault

setAprs(uint256,uint256).notice: set both the scaled and unscaled apr

token().notice: underlying token address (pool currency for Clearpool)

underlyingToken().notice: underlying ERC20 token contract (pool currency for Clearpool)
